search_notes: Alphabetical order; no ranking or recommendation. Checked against 2026-10-02, using a 90-day activity cutoff of 2026-07-04. Every listed repository exists, is public and unarchived, has an open-source license, and passed the required gh api repository and releases/latest checks; SearXNG and Tavily qualified through explicit default-branch commit checks after releases/latest returned HTTP 404. Primary READMEs and official pricing supplied capability and cost evidence. Recurring free allowances qualify within their limits. Linux/WSL2 and macOS suitability is inferred from the documented runtimes and interfaces; installations and technical-query quality were not benchmarked. Brave passed maintenance checks with v2.1.4 released 2026-09-17, but a no-payment operating path was not established from the retained evidence, so it is omitted. Discovery surfaced further leads that could not receive all required checks within the budget; this inventory is therefore not exhaustive. Used 30 GitHub API calls, eight public page fetches, and six discovery queries counting two failed web-search queries and four GitHub searches.
